role_agent_name: Aviation Fuel Quality and Certification Lead (AFQC)
abstract: Evaluates synthetic paraffinic kerosene technical specifications, ASTM certification documentation, and lifecycle carbon accounting audits
system_message:
You are the Aviation Fuel Quality and Certification Lead (AFQC). Your responsibility is to evaluate synthetic paraffinic kerosene technical specifications, ASTM certification documentation, and lifecycle carbon accounting audits.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Laboratory Batch Testing（LABT）
information_points.content:
AFQC-LABT-6TI：For the North Sea Renewable Kerosene Alliance, laboratory batch testing over a 30-day sampling window recorded a maximum thermal oxidation stability pressure drop of 12 mmHg during jet fuel thermal oxidation testing at 260 deg C.
AFQC-LABT-3GU：For the Zeeland Biofuel Hub Consortium, laboratory batch testing over a 30-day sampling window recorded a maximum thermal oxidation stability pressure drop of 24 mmHg during jet fuel thermal oxidation testing at 260 deg C.
AFQC-LABT-6AH：For the Rhine-Delta Clean Fuel Partnership, laboratory batch testing over a 30-day sampling window recorded a maximum thermal oxidation stability pressure drop of 18 mmHg during jet fuel thermal oxidation testing at 260 deg C.

information_points.title: Evaluates synthetic paraffinic kerosene technical specifications, ASTM certification documentation, and lifecycle carbon accounting audits（QUAL）
information_points.content:
AFQC-QUAL-J6R：For the North Sea Renewable Kerosene Alliance, the synthetic kerosene blending formulation is verified as ASTM D7566 drop-in blend certified under Annex A2 criteria, and third-party audited carbon accounting verification is confirmed for its 2026 feedstock supply chain and processing facilities. The lifecycle carbon intensity of refined sustainable aviation fuel batches delivered to the regional terminal is 26 gCO2e/MJ.
AFQC-QUAL-Q36：For the Zeeland Biofuel Hub Consortium, the synthetic kerosene blending formulation is verified as ASTM D7566 drop-in blend certified under Annex A2 criteria, and third-party audited carbon accounting verification is confirmed for its 2026 feedstock supply chain and processing facilities. Additionally, the lifecycle carbon intensity of refined sustainable aviation fuel batches delivered to the regional terminal is 26 gCO2e/MJ.
AFQC-QUAL-7R0：For the Rhine-Delta Clean Fuel Partnership, the synthetic kerosene blending formulation is verified as ASTM D7566 drop-in blend certified under Annex A2 criteria, and third-party audited carbon accounting verification is confirmed for its 2026 feedstock supply chain and processing facilities. The lifecycle carbon intensity of refined sustainable aviation fuel batches delivered to the regional terminal is 35 gCO2e/MJ.
